rationale.ai-review: Fine-tuned LLM independently detects and assesses issues in code diffs.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Localized explanations and repair suggestions help humans judge automated reviews.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented and benchmarked Carllm and multiple fine-tuned variants.
rationale.general-code: Reviewed diffs are general repository code, not specifically AI-generated.
rationale.risk-quality: System detects code issues and evaluates review-comment clarity and usefulness.
